verdict.rationale: Kong Dev Portal lets teams publish APIs (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specs, Markdown docs), browse/search documentation, try operations, and manage credentials with public or authenticated private visibility, while Kong Catalog provides a platform-level inventory across APIs, API packages, AI Models, MCP servers, and agents for org-wide discovery. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the portal/catalog experience beyond first-party docs, and concrete detail on team-based governance workflows in practice.
